title: DeltaHarness: Self-Evolving Harnesses for Resource-Adaptive Tool Execution
abstract: arXiv:2611.21688v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using agents rely on execution harnesses to organize and schedule tool operations. The same task and resource description can conceal runtime conditions that reverse the latency ordering of valid execution plans. Resolving this uncertainty requires firsthand execution in the target setting. We introduce DeltaHarness, an execution-guided policy-search method that adapts agent harnesses from cold-start measurements. Its QHI loop uses the observed response to update runtime dispatch, revise physical plans, and select experiments for later proposals. An independent confirmation panel controls policy replacement. With fixed dispatch, a revised materialization policy reduces complete-delivery latency by 30.0% on one video-editing task across three fresh pairs. On held-out tasks, the evolved policies reduce latency by 8.2% relative to the best fixed plan in one seed and by 4.6% relative to the initial proposal in another.

translated_title: DeltaHarness：面向资源自适应工具执行的自演化执行框架
translated_abstract: 使用工具的智能体依赖执行框架来组织和调度工具操作。相同的任务与资源描述可能隐藏着会颠倒有效执行计划延迟排序的运行时条件，而解决这种不确定性需要在目标环境中进行第一手执行。我们提出DeltaHarness，一种执行引导的策略搜索方法，可从冷启动测量中自适应调整智能体执行框架。其QHI循环利用观察到的响应来更新运行时调度、修订物理计划，并为后续提案选择实验，同时由独立的确认面板控制策略替换。在固定调度下，修订后的实体化策略在一个视频编辑任务的三对新配置上将完整交付延迟降低了30.0%。在保留任务上，演化出的策略在一个种子中相对于最佳固定计划将延迟降低8.2%，在另一个种子中相对于初始提案降低4.6%。
tldr: DeltaHarness是一种执行引导的策略搜索方法，通过QHI循环利用冷启动实测数据自演化智能体执行框架，使工具执行延迟在视频编辑等任务上最高降低30%。
en_tdlr: DeltaHarness is an execution-guided policy-search method that self-evolves agent harnesses from cold-start measurements via a QHI loop, cutting tool-execution latency by up to 30% on video-editing tasks.
